hookLine: One ad saved a dying brand overnight. Let's see how it holds up fifteen years later.

items.voiceLine: Rapid fire monologue, shirtless charm, and he's somehow already on a boat. This is the undisputed king of viral advertising. S-Tier, easily!

Jean-Claude Van Damme does a full split between two moving trucks, backwards, at highway speed, without a stunt double. No dialogue needed. Pure jaw-dropping spectacle. S-Tier, absolutely unforgettable.

outroLine: Still the king of viral advertising? Drop it below, and hit subscribe!
